literal: Greatness those-who-possess will-accomplish by-the-proper-way difficulty possessing deeds.
translation: Those who possess true greatness will accomplish, by the proper means, deeds of rare difficulty.
modern: பெருமைப் பண்பு உடையவர்கள், செய்வதற்கு அரிய செயல்களையும் உரிய நல்வழியில் செய்து முடிப்பார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the capability and methodology of noble individuals. Those who possess greatness of character (பெருமை உடையவர்) do not shy away from difficult tasks; they successfully perform (ஆற்றுவார்) deeds of rare difficulty (அருமை உடைய செயல்). Crucially, they do so 'ஆற்றின்'—meaning by the right path, method, or righteous means. Their greatness is defined not just by the magnitude of their achievements, but by their adherence to proper principles while achieving them.
